components.text: Calls the Host of the Beast near you (once), or makes the Host that is waiting change now. A full-moon night only, in the overworld; it needs the Valet Pike (given back), a Hearing Device and an echo shard.

A werewolf works it; Werewolves must be installed and the Beast switched on. If it cannot do anything it says why and gives everything back; a story that is over or under way only says that the frequency is silent.
